Over the first two seconds his eyes go wide; then he springs up off the stool, grabs his hair with both hands and slowly turns half round on the spot, so that we see his profile and then the back of his head, still clutching his hair; around the middle of the shot he turns back to three-quarter screen right, his hands slowly sliding down from his hair; in the last seconds his hands drop to his sides, his shoulders sag and his head droops, eyes on the muddy ground off screen right. His lips stay pressed together the whole shot, no talking, no mouthing words, no smile. He never looks into the camera.
